entries.title: Job 20:1
segments: ¶Then Zophar the Naamathite made answer and said,

entries.title: Job 20:2
segments: For this cause my thoughts are troubling me and driving me on.

entries.title: Job 20:3
segments: I have to give ear to arguments which put me to shame, and your answers to me are wind without wisdom.

entries.title: Job 20:4
segments: Have you knowledge of this from early times, when man was placed on the earth,

entries.title: Job 20:5
segments: That the pride of the sinner is short, and the joy of the evil-doer but for a minute?

entries.title: Job 20:6
segments: Though he is lifted up to the heavens, and his head goes up to the clouds;

entries.title: Job 20:7
segments: Like the waste from his body he comes to an end for ever: those who have seen him say, Where is he?

entries.title: Job 20:8
segments: He is gone like a dream, and is not seen again; he goes in flight like a vision of the night.

entries.title: Job 20:9
segments: The eye which saw him sees him no longer; and his place has no more knowledge of him.

entries.title: Job 20:10
segments: ¶His children are hoping that the poor will be kind to them, and his hands give back his wealth.

entries.title: Job 20:11
segments: His bones are full of young strength, but it will go down with him into the dust.

entries.title: Job 20:12
segments: Though evil-doing is sweet in his mouth, and he keeps it secretly under his tongue;

entries.title: Job 20:13
segments: Though he takes care of it, and does not let it go, but keeps it still in his mouth;

entries.title: Job 20:14
segments: His food becomes bitter in his stomach; the poison of snakes is inside him.

entries.title: Job 20:15
segments: He takes down wealth as food, and sends it up again; it is forced out of his stomach by God.

entries.title: Job 20:16
segments: He takes the poison of snakes into his mouth, the tongue of the snake is the cause of his death.

entries.title: Job 20:17
segments: Let him not see the rivers of oil, the streams of honey and milk.

entries.title: Job 20:18
segments: He is forced to give back the fruit of his work, and may not take it for food; he has no joy in the profit of his trading.

entries.title: Job 20:19
segments: Because he has been cruel to the poor, turning away from them in their trouble; because he has taken a house by force which he did not put up;

entries.title: Job 20:20
segments: There is no peace for him in his wealth, and no salvation for him in those things in which he took delight.

entries.title: Job 20:21
segments: He had never enough for his desire; for this cause his well-being will quickly come to an end.

entries.title: Job 20:22
segments: Even when his wealth is great, he is full of care, for the hand of everyone who is in trouble is turned against him.

entries.title: Job 20:23
segments: ¶God gives him his desire, and sends the heat of his wrath on him, making it come down on him like rain.

entries.title: Job 20:24
segments: He may go in flight from the iron spear, but the arrow from the bow of brass will go through him;

entries.title: Job 20:25
segments: He is pulling it out, and it comes out of his back; and its shining point comes out of his side; he is overcome by fears.

entries.title: Job 20:26
segments: All his wealth is stored up for the dark: a fire not made by man sends destruction on him, and on everything in his tent.

entries.title: Job 20:27
segments: The heavens make clear his sin, and the earth gives witness against him.

entries.title: Job 20:28
segments: The produce of his house is taken away into another country, like things given into the hands of others in the day of wrath.

entries.title: Job 20:29
segments: This is the reward of the evil man, and the heritage given to him by God.
